run_all_benchmarks: run all benchmark files in the current directory by executing bm_main.py with no arguments
run_selected_benchmarks: run specific benchmark files by passing their names as arguments to bm_main.py
run_benchmark_with_env: run a benchmark file with PYTHONPATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH forwarded to the subprocess
discover_benchmark_files: discover all benchmark files matching the bm_*.py pattern in the benchmarks directory
execute_benchmark_subprocess: execute a single benchmark Python file as a subprocess using the current Python interpreter
